lines.t: It's just me and these walls
Tryin' to make sense of the silence
Walkin' the long road
Holdin' a little hand
World's throwin' stones
But I can't let my hurt be the anchor
I'm learning to let go
Lay down resentment's brand
But there's a love that never leaves
There's a hand stronger than mine
For every ache, every broken plea
He's near every time
Caught in His embrace
Each tear's a seed of grace
I'm not alone
I'm carried in his arms tonight
My heart aches to be known
Loneliness cutting deep as thunder
Still I swallow complaint
Try not to let along and win
The weight gets heavy
When love feels like a hunger
But I thank Him for His sacrifice
Learning to love within
There's a love that covers shame
A peace stronger than pain
When I'm tempted to numb the ache
He invites me in again
So I lay it at His feet
Let His kindness make me whole
Letting go of every bitter memory I hold
Oh, forgiveness is the hardest road to travel
Especially when family wounds bleed through the years
But I'm letting mercy plant its flag in the battle
Where His voice chases out my fears
It's not fair
Giving all this love with no return
But I hold fast
arms of faith the only rest i know learning to pour love not expecting it back in kind
he grows my roots down deep where living waters flow
there's a healer in the silence a whisper through the storm he tells me i am worthy
Even when I feel torn
On the days I just can't believe
His truth is the anchor I need
I'm found, I'm known
In His love I am free
So I'll meet you in the quiet
Where your love makes all things new
in the secret place beyond the eight my heart is held by you yes there's a love that never leaves
there's a hand holding mine for each night every secret plea you're near every time
Caught in your embrace
Each tear redeemed by grace
I'm not alone
I'm carried in your arms tonight
I'm not alone
Your love makes everything right
